extraction.Name: Peter Bordeaux
extraction.Refused/Protested: Did you make any protest to any one when this patent was received? Yes
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged it and then sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: By odd jobs, farming and so forth
extraction.NOTES: Received $2000 as follows: purchaser paid three mortgages, gave $100 in cash, sold a Ford car for $735.00, and promised to pay remainder of $250 which was never confirmed received; allottee believes William Bordeaux (agent for Tackett) may have collected the $250 at the bank in Kilgore; satisfied with the sale; patent received in St. Francis; patent was sent by mail and receipt was signed; has 6 living children, 3 of which are at home and dependent on him; notary: S. W. Cross, commission expires 4/28/32; sworn March 25, 1929
